item.title: Wine, Beer, Whisky and Spices: Kiddush, Shabbat Meals and Havdala | Laws of Shabbat 2018 · #2
item.description:
Wine, Beer, Whisky and Spices: Kiddush, Shabbat Meals and Havdala Laws of Shabbat — Shiur 2 of 14 · Dayan Daniel Kada
Kiddush — why it matters, grape juice, wine, cups, and Kiddush on Halla; Shabbat meals — bread, Kiddush in shul, and diets; Havdala — without besamim, the next morning, and before Shabbat ends when travelling.
Recorded at Tiferet Eyal, Hendon (2018–19), as part of a 14-part course on the laws of Shabbat.
▶ Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/SyYC7y80wFk

item.title: The Shabbat Kitchen Part 1: Cooking and She'hiyah | Laws of Shabbat 2018 · #3
item.description:
The Shabbat Kitchen Part 1: Cooking and She'hiyah Laws of Shabbat — Shiur 3 of 14 · Dayan Daniel Kada
Bishul — cooking defined, the sun and derivatives of fire, Yad Soledet Bo, Kli Sheni and making hot drinks, croutons in soup, reheating solids, liquids and Hamin, and stirring; She'hiyah — hotplates, blechs, and holidays without either.
Recorded at Tiferet Eyal, Hendon (2018–19), as part of a 14-part course on the laws of Shabbat.
▶ Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/qEHV4GJetig

item.title: The Shabbat Kitchen Part 2: Hazara and Hatmana | Laws of Shabbat 2018 · #4
item.description:
The Shabbat Kitchen Part 2: Hazara and Hatmana Laws of Shabbat — Shiur 4 of 14 · Dayan Daniel Kada
A recap of Bishul, then Hazara — returning food to a source of heat — and Hatmana — wrapping food; a practical guide to hotplates, blechs, crockpots, ovens and urns.
Recorded at Tiferet Eyal, Hendon (2018–19), as part of a 14-part course on the laws of Shabbat.

item.title: The Shabbat Kitchen Part 3: Threshing and Selecting | Laws of Shabbat 2018 · #5
item.description:
The Shabbat Kitchen Part 3: Threshing and Selecting Laws of Shabbat — Shiur 5 of 14 · Dayan Daniel Kada
Dash — squeezing fruit (a lemon on salad or in tea), milking and expressing, crushing ice and using soap; Borer — the conditions for selecting, bones in fish and chicken, and setting the table.

item.title: The Shabbat Kitchen Part 4: Grinding, Kneading and Pickling | Laws of Shabbat 2018 · #6
item.description:
The Shabbat Kitchen Part 4: Grinding, Kneading and Pickling Laws of Shabbat — Shiur 6 of 14 · Dayan Daniel Kada
Tohen — grinding and mashing (eggs, avocado, food for immediate use); Lash — kneading, thick versus loose mixtures, tehina and egg mayonnaise; Me'abed — pickling and salting salads.
Recorded at Tiferet Eyal, Hendon (2018–19), as part of a 14-part course on the laws of Shabbat.

item.title: Out and About: Ploughing, Planting and Harvesting | Laws of Shabbat 2018 · #7
item.description:
Out and About: Ploughing, Planting and Harvesting Laws of Shabbat — Shiur 7 of 14 · Dayan Daniel Kada
Horesh — ploughing (football studs, marbles, football); Zore'a — planting (picnics, flowers in a vase); Kotser — harvesting (hammocks, trees, touching and smelling plants).
